article.title: Monterrey notes
article.excerpt: Most of all, I was surprised at how beautiful the city setting is — gleaming skyscrapers surrounded by green mountains. The red Faro del Comercio is the city’s landmark, in honor of the 100th anniversary of the founding of the city’s Chamber of Commerce. You can visit an excellent old iron works factory .
